newsitem.title: JORDAN: Peugeot's sporty 406 coupe on sale in May.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot's sporty 406 coupe on sale in May.

text.p: Automobiles Peugeot wants to make driving a pleasure with the sporty 406 coupe, styled by Italy's Pininfarina, that goes on sale in France on May 15.

Automobiles Peugeot, a division of the PSA Peugeot Citroen group, hopes to sell 10,000 406 coupes this year, boosting its share of the upper range of Europe's mid-sized segment to 10 percent from eight percent last year.

The coupe, which seats four, will come in two versions, a two-liter engine with 135 horsepower, and a V6 engine with 194 horsepower. It will be priced from 170,000 to 235,000 francs, officials said at a weekend presentation here of the model.
Built in two Pininfarina plants in Italy, the 406 coupe will be available in much of western Europe in June and July.

Peugeot is counting on the car's aesthetics to help it make inroads in the target markets of Germany, Britain and Italy, countries where coupes have significant annual sales of between 22,000 to 35,000, compared with fewer than 8,000 in France.
Company officials said they expect the V6 version to account for over half of the sales, possibly as many as three-fourths.
